levels.surface: علي بن أحمد بن محمد بن عمران الدقاق
محمد بن أبي عبد الله الكوفي

notes: RULING NEEDED (rule 11): a narrated encounter in which Amir al-Mu'minin speaks and acts (the sermon, the call «الصلاة جامعة»). Ali is not added as a link; the Imam named after «سمعت» is the last link.
The Imam is named in the words after the chain («سمعت أبا عبد الله ... يقول»): imam_in_text (owner ruling 2).
